use_case_summary: SMB support automation vendor. Primary goal: hosted API for fast self-serve POC to auto-summarize inbound tickets, extract structured fields (issue_type, priority, customer_tier), and perform function/tool calls to their ticket system to set status/assign. Expect to start on public cloud; low initial security friction but SOC2 and SAML planned. If POC shows performance/cost benefits, move to higher commit or Dedicated plan.
